_doc: What a reorg REBUILD (#3411, src/reorgGuard.ts) keeps on top of src/diamondEpochKeep.json. A rebuild replays the SAME Diamond from its deploy block, so every row born off chain stays valid for it; this is the restore runbook's clear-and-replay treatment (docs/ops/OffChainRestore.md) applied to one chain. `keep`: chain-scoped born-off-chain tables the Diamond keep list does not already name (those are Diamond-keyed dedupe rows a Diamond change must clear, but a rebuild of the same Diamond must not). `project`: chain-scoped hybrid tables, kept with the replay-maintained columns set back to where the scan starts, the same values as the restore converter's RESTORE_PROJECTIONS. scripts/check-table-classification.mjs holds both lists equal to the classification.

keep.notify_state: HF-band alert dedupe for the same Diamond's loans; clearing it would send every open loan's alert again
keep.pre_grace_notify_state: pre-grace warning dedupe for the same Diamond's loans; clearing it would send every warning again

signed_offers.reason: the user's signed orders: the order and signature were posted by the user and no replay can recreate them; their fill and cancel state is the chain's, so it restarts as unfilled and the replay re-applies every fill, cancel and nonce burn
